card.name: Punctuation inside food and crop lists
card.fires_on: Commas, dashes and small linking words in lists of foods or crops, right before the next food or crop name. Seen in crop lists, food rations and recipe-style titles.

modes.label: Commas in crop lists
modes.description: A comma between crop names in a list of crops.

modes.label: Dashes in food or ration lists
modes.description: A dash or unit word just before the next food item in a supply list.
modes.example: - High energy foods<<-->>peanut butter, jelly, crackers,

modes.label: Linking words before a food
modes.description: A small word like my or with just before a food name in a title.
modes.example: DO I HAVE TO EAT<< MY>> TOMATOES?

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward food or plant names starting with App, Ber or Pot, such as apple, berry or potato.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a food or crop list where the next item, such as a fruit or vegetable, is about to be named.
